# 2026-08-13 to 2026-08-14, every split and figure the same, for
# `--strategy update`.

# A disposal's date is when it drew the cost basis down. Nothing else draws
# on the fee, so the edit is read as a new transaction would be (Q-051): what
# it drew is given back, and it draws the same 0.72 on its new date.
#

# tests/integration/test_an_edit_may_move_the_split_that_sets_the_rate.py.
